The '''shards''' were three [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] that were created by the [[Oblee]] [[Species/Legends|species]].

==History==
Thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[shadow creature]] traveled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Oblis]] in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] and settled into the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of the world. The [[Oblee]], a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that were native to Oblis, came to view the creature as a threat and the Oblee [[scientist-philosopher]]s built a [[Unidentified Oblis machine|weapon]] to harness the abilities of the [[Darkstaff]]&mdash;a [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]]&mdash;to repulse the shadow creature from the planet. In order to power their machine, the scientist-philosophers created three [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] shards that could channel the hopes and fears of the Oblee into the Darkstaff. They then placed the shards at strategic locations around Oblis: one mounted on a pole in a marketplace, one on an altar inside a [[temple]] that served the Oblee [[Priests of Nether]] and one inside a great hall in which the philosophers' weapon had been situated. The entire Oblee species focused their thoughts onto the crystals, to channel their energies into the Darkstaff, and a [[Unidentified Oblee scientist-philosopher|scientist-philosopher]] inserted the staff and one of the shards into the machine. The device successfully removed the shadow creature from Oblis, but the Darkstaff used the energy that it had absorbed from the shards to trigger a chain reaction that [[Destruction of Oblis|destroyed]] Oblis seconds later. The shards were left unharmed by the cataclysm and the Oblee were transformed into incoporeal beings that became known as "shadow lurkers." The Darkstaff continued to draw energy from the Oblee via the shards and as a result, the shadow lurkers were forced to take in energy from anything that they could reach, in order to prevent themselves from being completely absorbed by the artifact.

The remains of Oblis eventually settled to form the [[Cularin asteroid belt]] and the shards came to be located inside a small [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] within the [[Asteroid field/Legends|belt]]. In about [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], a group of [[Heroes of Cularin|freelance agents]] traveled to the asteroid and the shadow lurkers urged them to destroy the shards, to sever the lurkers' connection to the Darkstaff. However, the Darkstaff learned of the agents plans and it dispatched a team of [[Believers]] to prevent the agents from destroying the shards. The agents [[Skirmish in the Cularin asteroid belt|defeated]] the Believers and shattered the shards, severing the shadow lurkers' connection to the Darkstaff and allowing the Oblee to be reborn in physical form.
